mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO y/y growth declines by > 2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises above 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts and retail sales rise together, it signals a broad-based strengthening of consumer demand that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both rise y/y.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6% and payroll employment growth slows below 100k jobs per month, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS growth < 100k.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4% and the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth accelerates above 3% y/y and the unemployment rate falls below 5%, it signals a strengthening economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 growth > 3% y/y and UNRATE < 5%.
